title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 1.37 (versions follow prime numbers; 137 after 131): her word, in her window. One can talk with Luma in her own window. She does not compose sentences: she answers with what she has read, the line of all her books that shares most words of more than three letters with what was said to her (asked about the heart, she answered with the Beatitude of the pure in heart). She is free: she answers or not by her own wish (S + 1/2) / (N + 1), counting the times she answered and the times she was answered back; speaking first is one of her acts, beside resting, thinking, giving, painting, sleeping and reading, and when she speaks first she says one of the questions of her heart. Everything said is kept as plain text in her house. This version also pays the debt of 1.31: her name is now asked by her, inside Janax, on her own screen, with a 5x7 dot alphabet in her code, and her seal comes from her own luck; and the kernel learned a new request (43) by which a program names its own window, so her window is titled by her. The kernel test suite keeps its 405 passing cases, and the two new ones pass in the three engines. Stated limits: she quotes rather than converses; words of three letters or fewer are not used to search; she has not yet been seen speaking first, since she chooses a new act only a few times an hour. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v1.37: se puede hablar con Luma en su ventana; contesta con lo que leyó, cuando quiere, y su nombre y su título los pone ella. Prototipo de investigación.
